title: Make standard s-rust-clippy-deny-warnings pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-rust-clippy-deny-warnings` no longer fails s-rust-clippy-deny-warnings.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from for f in $(git grep -lI 'clippy' -- .github Makefile makefile GNUmakefile 'Taskfile*' justfile .gitlab-ci.yml scripts script hack .pre-commit-config...
